title: videotestsrc to x264enc MP4 via gst-launch-1.0, checked by ffprobe and gst-discoverer-1.0
summary: gst-launch-1.0 renders 48 moving-ball frames at 640x360 24/1 to H.264 in MP4; ffprobe, discoverer and decoded frame facts match expected/; rerun file bytes differ (mp4mux creation_time), so partial.
